title: Evaluating generative models for structure-based drug discovery from de novo design to lead optimization.
authors: Cao, Duanhua; Fan, Zhehuan; Yu, Jie; Chen, Mingan; Jiang, Xinyu; Sheng, Xia; Wang, Xingyou; Zeng, Chuanlong; Luo, Xiaomin; Teng, Dan; Zheng, Mingyue
one_liner_zh: 该文提出MolGenBench基准，系统评估17种生成模型在基于结构的药物设计中的从头生成和先导优化能力，虽以配体生成为核心，但紧密关联蛋白质结构预测与结构感知的分子生成，对蛋白质结构计算建模有直接参考价值。
abstract: Advances in protein structure prediction have created opportunities for structure-based drug design, yet translating structural knowledge into actionable small-molecule ligands remains difficult. Existing benchmarks often use simplified datasets and computational surrogates that poorly capture the heterogeneity and constraints of real-world drug discovery. We introduce MolGenBench, a comprehensive benchmark for de novo molecular generation and hit-to-lead optimization built on a large, structurally diverse dataset. Evaluation of 17 leading methods reveals persistent limitations, including weak virtual-screening performance, limited coverage of target-specific bioactive space, frequent high-risk structural motifs, poor target awareness, and reduced generalization to unseen proteins. Although some models improve three-dimensional conformation generation, they still struggle to produce active molecules reliably. MolGenBench provides standardized data, metrics, and analyses that connect structural prediction with practical molecular design and guide the development of more effective structure-based generative models.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质结构预测的进展为基于结构的药物设计创造了机遇，但将结构知识转化为可操作的小分子配体仍然困难重重。现有基准测试常使用简化数据集和计算替代指标，难以充分捕捉真实药物发现的异质性和约束条件。我们引入了MolGenBench，一个基于大规模、结构多样化数据集的从头分子生成和先导化合物优化综合基准。对17种领先方法的评估揭示了持续存在的局限性，包括虚拟筛选性能薄弱、靶标特异性生物活性空间覆盖有限、频繁出现高风险结构基序、靶标感知能力不足，以及对未见蛋白质的泛化能力降低。尽管一些模型改善了三维构象生成，它们仍难以可靠地产生活性分子。MolGenBench提供了标准化的数据、指标和分析，将结构预测与实际分子设计相连接，并指导更有效的基于结构的生成模型的发展。
